summary: A realtime 1v1 against u6bkep on Comet Catcher, won at 18:03 when the body killed his commander at B4; 55 of his units and buildings, the commander among them, died 18:03-18:07, and the record ended at 18:14. We out-expanded him from 7:00 (17 extractors to 5 seen, 22 to 5 at 10:00) and led in army from 3:00 on, never under 1.8x his seen army. The first raiders crossed at 2:00 but roved our own half and then died piecemeal to his Blitzes and commander at B4/C4 (4:40-5:27); no building of his died until the body reached his south spots at 9:38. The body's first assault on his plants (10:56-11:22) went in at 13-17 soldiers with a plant's output kept home as a picket and energy empty, and was called off at 9 left; five minutes of split fights at C4/E4 followed while his Stouts raided our middle and he added an air plant and, by 17:30, an advanced vehicle plant. The game ended when a gathered 41-soldier body (7.8k) went in as one on the go_b4 signal at 16:53.

root.what: The game never left the winning path; this root marks where the win was delayed by about six minutes (the reader's reading, no person commented). At 8:22 the player made plant_20622's whole output a home picket at spot_18, while the commander's 8:05 direction kept only two Blitzes home; with energy empty from 8:17, the body that reached his plants at 10:56 was 13-17 soldiers of a 4.4-4.9k army. The attack was called off at 11:22 with 9 left, and the end needed a second, gathered push at 16:53.

their_play: u6bkep (Armada) opened one vehicle plant at B4, seen at 2:15, with Blitzes and his commander at home. They beat our piecemeal raiders at B4/C4 (4:40-5:27) and sent pairs of Blitzes onto our strip (H3 4:16, H2 5:29, E3 6:14). He walled his base with Sentries at spot_36, 28, 45 and 67, put a heavy laser tower at C3 by 6:55 and a radar, and held few extractors in sight: 4-7 all game, his south four lost at 9:38-9:54. He built energy heavily (12 solars, 4 advanced solars and 2 energy stores died at his base). He went air: a Peeper at 9:16, Thunders at 9:19, five bombing our home extractor at 10:06, the air plant at B4 seen at 10:52. From about 10:50 he fought with Stouts and Janus: 5-Stout raids into our middle took 4 extractors at 12:36-13:24, and his main army (9-12 Stouts, 2-3 Janus) met our split groups at C4 and E4 (13:49-16:08). He had an advanced vehicle plant up by 17:30 (an armacv seen at 17:29), too late: the 41-soldier body killed the advanced plant, the air plant and his commander at B4 by 18:03, and the rest of his side died with the commander by 18:07. He wrote nothing in the chat.

22-23 extractors to his 4-7 seen at 10:00-12:00 paid for the army that won. The count fell to 18 by 16:00 when constructors went to the plants and his Stouts raided the middle.

The handful crossed at 2:00-2:03 (on the pool's clock) but roved our half and then fought inside his base, killing no building until 9:38. Whether it held his extractors at 4-7 is not shown: there is no truth file.
His south spots at B8 (a Sentry, 4 extractors) fell in 16 s at 9:38-9:54 once the body went round the C3 tower to them.
The same person, as the opponent, went air (Thunders 9:19, air plant seen 10:52). Our pre-emptive Nettles (7:53, 9:32) and Whistlers killed his five bombers at home for one extractor.

plant_20622 idle 2:52-3:08 after a produce call with only a group dropped its list (a harness defect).

lens.caveats: No ledger row exists for human-29 and no review.md. No person commented on the game: the chat holds only our banner and 'gl hf', the person wrote nothing, and the user was silent. There is no truth file, so his army, extractors and economy are what we saw (floors). pro_baseline found no carded side for G1, so its rows come from --all-starts (all starts, Armada, OS 40+), and its pressure rows and 'army metal in his half' column are blank; minutes.py gave the crossing clocks instead. The root is the reader's reading of a won game. The impedance and unfinished reviews are model readings, cited as such; the reader did not re-run impedance_sweep.py. Not checked: whether the produce-drops-list, the outweigh report and the commander's turret count have since been fixed.

open_questions: Did the early raids and the body keep him at 4-7 extractors, or were more of his unseen? There is no truth file.
What blocked the spot_6 home extractor (no_site from 10:59 to the end): the bombed extractor's wreck, our Nettle at (6248, 632), or plant_20622's footprint?
Would the 10:56 assault on B4 have ended the game with the home picket (about 1.5k) and full energy behind it? This is the reader's root; no person has looked at the game.
How close was his tier 2 to mattering? The advanced vehicle plant and an armacv were first seen at 17:29-17:30, and when they were started is unknown.
